title: The Betrayal of Kuro
summary: The truth behind the Primordial Binding is fully unmasked as Ha-Jun and the redeemed Kuro wage a ferocious aerial duel against Emperor Nihilux above Seoul.

panels.shot: emperor nihilux drawing twin 50-foot greatswords of black void steel
panels.action: Nihilux unsheathes two colossal jagged blades forged from the cores of collapsed black holes.

dialogue.speaker: nihilux
dialogue.text: Even with your bird restored, you are but dust before the First Emperor of the Void!

panels.prose_en: Nihilux unsheathes two colossal jagged blades forged from the cores of collapsed black holes.
panels.prose_hi: Nihilax ne dhahe hue black hole ke core se bane do vishal dantedar bledon ko khol diya.

panels.shot: nihilux leaping forward with seismic force shattering the courtyard lawn
panels.action: Nihilux leaps with the force of an artillery barrage, his twin blades cleaving downward at Mach 10.
panels.prose_en: Nihilux leaps with the force of an artillery barrage, his twin blades cleaving downward at Mach 10.
panels.prose_hi: Nihilax ek topkhane ki takat se chhalang lagata hai, uske judwan blade mac 10 ki gati se neeche ki or tutate han.

panels.shot: ha-jun meeting both blades with the sanguine fang: blinding shockwave
panels.action: Ha-Jun parries both 50-foot swords with his single seven-foot blade; the shockwave blows all clouds from the sky.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun parries both 50-foot swords with his single seven-foot blade; the shockwave blows all clouds from the sky.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun apne saat foot ke blade se 50 foot ki donon talwaron ko kaat deta hai; shockwev aakash se sabhi baadalon ko uda deti hai.

panels.shot: kuro swooping from above driving blazing talons into nihilux helm
panels.action: Kuro swoops down at Mach 12, driving his white-hot solar talons into Nihilux's armored horned faceplate.

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: THAT IS FOR CONTROLLING MY MIND, YOU SLIME!!

panels.prose_en: Kuro swoops down at Mach 12, driving his white-hot solar talons into Nihilux's armored horned faceplate.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro ne much 12 ki gati se jhapatta mara aur apne safed-garm saur panje ko nihilax ke bakhtarband seeng wale faceplate mein daal diya.

panels.shot: nihilux staggering back his faceplate gouged and smoking
panels.action: Nihilux stumbles backward three steps, dark oil-blood leaking from four deep gouges across his metal visor.
panels.prose_en: Nihilux stumbles backward three steps, dark oil-blood leaking from four deep gouges across his metal visor.
panels.prose_hi: Nihilax teen kadam peeche ki or ladkhadata hai, uske dhatu ke chhajje par lage char gahre chhedon se gehra tel-rakt ris raha hai.

panels.shot: tae-jun from the ground firing a beam of concentrated bronze mana
panels.action: Tae-Jun thrusts his right palm forward, firing a concentrated laser of bronze guardian mana into Nihilux's knee.
panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun thrusts his right palm forward, firing a concentrated laser of bronze guardian mana into Nihilux's knee.
panels.prose_hi: Taaye-jun ne apni dahini hatheli ko aage badhaya, jisse nihilax ke ghutne mein kansya sanrakshak man ka ek kendrit laser fire hua.

panels.shot: nihilux knee buckling again as ha-jun dashes into his guard
panels.action: Taking advantage of the stagger, Ha-Jun blurs inside Nihilux's reach, his blade spinning in a crimson blur.
panels.prose_en: Taking advantage of the stagger, Ha-Jun blurs inside Nihilux's reach, his blade spinning in a crimson blur.
panels.prose_hi: Ladkhadahat ka fayda uthate hue, ha-jun nihilax ki pahunch ke andar dhundhla ho jata hai, uska blade gahre lal rang mein ghumta hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun executing a seven-slash combination across nihilux torso
panels.action: Seven blinding cuts carve through Nihilux's breastplate, exposing the glowing green anti-matter core inside.
panels.prose_en: Seven blinding cuts carve through Nihilux's breastplate, exposing the glowing green anti-matter core inside.
panels.prose_hi: Saat chakachaundh cut nihilax ke brestaplate ke madhyam se ukere gaye han, jo andar chamakte hare anti-mater core ko ujagar karte han.

panels.shot: nihilux roaring in fury releasing an anti-matter pulse point blank
panels.action: Nihilux detonates a defensive pulse of black antimatter, blasting Ha-Jun backward 100 feet through the air.
panels.prose_en: Nihilux detonates a defensive pulse of black antimatter, blasting Ha-Jun backward 100 feet through the air.
panels.prose_hi: Nihilax kale antimatter ki ek rakshatmak pulse ka visfot karta hai, jisse ha-jun hawa mein 100 feet peeche chala jata hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun backflipping through the air landing lightly on a flagpole
panels.action: Ha-Jun lands with acrobatic poise atop the university center flagpole, his coat fluttering gracefully.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun lands with acrobatic poise atop the university center flagpole, his coat fluttering gracefully.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun kalabaji ke saath vishwavidyalaya kendra ke dhwajastambh ke upar utarta hai, uska coat khubsurti se lahra raha hai.

panels.shot: nihilux summoning the remaining two void thrones to earth
panels.action: Nihilux raises his hand: 'Baal-Zahar! Lilith-Morg! Descend and feast upon these children!'

dialogue.speaker: nihilux
dialogue.text: Sovereigns of Blood and Soul! Destroy them!!

panels.prose_en: Nihilux raises his hand: 'Baal-Zahar! Lilith-Morg! Descend and feast upon these children!'.
panels.prose_hi: Nihilax ne apna haath uthaya: 'bal-zhar! lilith-morg! utaro aur in bachchon ka anand lo!'

panels.shot: two massive dimensional rifts opening beside nihilux
panels.action: Two colossal rifts tear open; Lord Baal-Zahar and Empress Lilith-Morg step onto the Seoul battlefield.
panels.prose_en: Two colossal rifts tear open; Lord Baal-Zahar and Empress Lilith-Morg step onto the Seoul battlefield.
panels.prose_hi: Do vishal dararen khul gain; lord bal-zhar aur maharani lilith-morg seoul yudh ke maidan mein kadam rakhte han.

panels.shot: baal-zahar boiling a river of corrosive blood across the streets
panels.action: Baal-Zahar unleashes a boiling wave of toxic red blood that melts asphalt and cars along the boulevard.
panels.prose_en: Baal-Zahar unleashes a boiling wave of toxic red blood that melts asphalt and cars along the boulevard.
panels.prose_hi: Bal-zhar jahreele lal rakt ki ubalti lahar ko ujagar karta hai jo buleward ke saath damar aur karon ko pighla deta hai.

panels.shot: lilith-morg wailing a banshee soul-scream that disorients soldiers
panels.action: Lilith-Morg emits an ultrasonic soul-wail that causes human and demon soldiers to drop to their knees clutching ears.
panels.prose_en: Lilith-Morg emits an ultrasonic soul-wail that causes human and demon soldiers to drop to their knees clutching ears.
panels.prose_hi: Lilith-morg ek ultrasonic aatma-vilap ka utsarjan karta hai jiske karan manav aur rakshas sainik kaan pakadkar ghutnon ke bal baith jaate han.

panels.shot: ha-jun looking down at his suffering soldiers with fierce compassion
panels.action: Ha-Jun looks down at his allies: 'I will not allow you to slaughter my people!'
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun looks down at his allies: 'I will not allow you to slaughter my people!'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun apne sahyogiyon ki or dekhta hai: 'main tumhe mere logon ka vadh karne ki anumati nahin dunga!'

panels.shot: ha-jun invoking the crown of the sovereign: monarch's domain 10 miles
panels.action: Ha-Jun activates the Crown's full power: a 10-mile golden dome covers all of Seoul, silencing the soul-wail.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun activates the Crown's full power: a 10-mile golden dome covers all of Seoul, silencing the soul-wail.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun crown ki puri shakti ko sakriya karta hai: 10 meal ka sunhara gumbad poore seoul ko cover karta hai, jo aatma-vilap ko shant karta hai.

panels.shot: the banshee wail neutralized and the corrosive blood purified to water
panels.action: Within Ha-Jun's domain, Lilith-Morg's wail is silenced and Baal-Zahar's toxic blood turns into crystal-clear clean water.

dialogue.text: Within the Sovereign's domain, only the King's law exists.

panels.prose_en: Within Ha-Jun's domain, Lilith-Morg's wail is silenced and Baal-Zahar's toxic blood turns into crystal-clear clean water.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun ke domain ke bheetar, lilith-morg ka vilap shant ho jata hai aur bal-zhar ka jahreela khoon cristal-spasht saaf pani mein badal jata hai.

panels.shot: baal-zahar and lilith-morg staring at their nullified spells in shock
panels.action: The two Void Sovereigns stare at their hands in disbelief: 'Our primordial spells... Nullified in an instant?!'

dialogue.speaker: baal_zahar
dialogue.text: His domain authority exceeds even the First Sovereign's records!

panels.prose_en: The two Void Sovereigns stare at their hands in disbelief: 'Our primordial spells... Nullified in an instant?!'.
panels.prose_hi: Do shunya samprabhu log avishvas se apne hathon ko dekh rahe han: 'hamare aadim mantra... ek pal mein nirast ho gaye?!'.

panels.shot: ha-jun appearing between baal-zahar and lilith-morg in a flash of starlight
panels.action: Ha-Jun materializes directly between the two gods, his Sanguine Fang already swung in a 360-degree arc.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun materializes directly between the two gods, his Sanguine Fang already swung in a 360-degree arc.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun sidhe do devtaon ke beech sakar hota hai, uska senguin fang pehle se hi 360-degri chaap mein ghum gaya hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun slicing through both baal-zahar and lilith-morg simultaneously
panels.action: A single fluid horizontal circular slash cleanly beheads Lord Baal-Zahar and bisects Empress Lilith-Morg.
panels.prose_en: A single fluid horizontal circular slash cleanly beheads Lord Baal-Zahar and bisects Empress Lilith-Morg.
panels.prose_hi: Ek ekal drav kshaitij golakar slash bhagwan bal-zhar ka sir saaf kar deta hai aur maharani lilith-morg ko dvibhajit karta hai.

panels.shot: both void sovereigns exploding into massive clouds of grey ash
panels.action: The two ancient gods disintegrate into two towering pillars of grey ash that dissolve harmlessly in the wind.
panels.prose_en: The two ancient gods disintegrate into two towering pillars of grey ash that dissolve harmlessly in the wind.
panels.prose_hi: Do prachin devta bhure raakh ke do oonche khambhon mein vighatit ho gaye jo hawa mein hanirahit roop se ghul gaye.

panels.shot: nihilux standing alone, his four hands trembling in first true fear
panels.action: Emperor Nihilux stands completely alone in the center of the boulevard, his remaining twin blades shaking.

dialogue.speaker: nihilux
dialogue.text: Both of them... In a fraction of a second... This boy is not a mortal!

panels.prose_en: Emperor Nihilux stands completely alone in the center of the boulevard, his remaining twin blades shaking.
panels.prose_hi: Samrat nihilax buleward ke kendra mein bilkul akele khade han, unke shesh judwan blade hill rahe han.

panels.shot: ha-jun turning toward nihilux his eyes burning with cold judgment
panels.action: Ha-Jun turns around slowly, his blood katana dripping stardust: 'Now it's just you and me, Nihilux.'
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun turns around slowly, his blood katana dripping stardust: 'Now it's just you and me, Nihilux.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun dhire-dhire ghumta hai, uska khoon katana stardust tapka raha hai: 'ab yah sirf aap aur main han, nihilax.'

panels.shot: tae-jun stepping up to ha-jun right side claymore drawn
panels.action: Tae-Jun joins his right side, bronze armor gleaming: 'Make that you, me, and our brother.'
panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun joins his right side, bronze armor gleaming: 'Make that you, me, and our brother.'.
panels.prose_hi: Taaye-jun apne dahini or judta hai, kansya kavach chamakta hai: 'ise tum, mujhe aur hamare bhai ko banao.'

panels.shot: kuro landing on ha-jun left shoulder wings flaring proudly
panels.action: Kuro settles on his left shoulder, eyes blazing ruby: 'And don't forget the bird.'
panels.prose_en: Kuro settles on his left shoulder, eyes blazing ruby: 'And don't forget the bird.'.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro apne baen kandhe par baith jata hai, uski aankhen ruby chamakti han: 'aur pakshi ko mat bhulna.'

panels.shot: nihilux screaming in desperate madness charging all his void energy
panels.action: Nihilux screams, channeling the remaining dark matter of a thousand dead stars into his chest core.

dialogue.speaker: nihilux
dialogue.text: IF I DIE, I WILL DRAG THIS ENTIRE CONTINENT TO HELL WITH ME!!

panels.prose_en: Nihilux screams, channeling the remaining dark matter of a thousand dead stars into his chest core.
panels.prose_hi: Nihilax chillata hai, ek hajar mrit sitaron ke shesh kale padarth ko apni chhati ke core mein pravahit karta hai.

panels.shot: nihilux chest core expanding into an unstable supernova bomb
panels.action: His chest core swells into a blinding sphere of unstable green anti-matter, ready to vaporize Korea.
panels.prose_en: His chest core swells into a blinding sphere of unstable green anti-matter, ready to vaporize Korea.
panels.prose_hi: Uski chhati ka core asthir hare anti-mater ke ek chakachaundh kshetra mein badal jata hai, jo korea ko vashpikrit karne ke liye taiyar hai.

panels.shot: tae-jun lunging forward to pin nihilux arms with his claymore
panels.action: Tae-Jun sprints forward, driving his claymore through Nihilux's wrists, pinning the monster's arms to the ground.
panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun sprints forward, driving his claymore through Nihilux's wrists, pinning the monster's arms to the ground.
panels.prose_hi: Taaye-jun aage badhta hai, apne clamor ko nihilax ki kalaiyon ke madhyam se chalata hai, rakshas ki bhujaon ko jameen par daba deta hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun channeling the hourglass and the sanguine fang for the final strike
panels.action: Ha-Jun leaps into the air, holding the Sanguine Fang with both hands, starlight and chronos sand fusing on the edge.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun leaps into the air, holding the Sanguine Fang with both hands, starlight and chronos sand fusing on the edge.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun hawa mein chhalang lagata hai, donon hathon se senguin feng ko pakadta hai, taron ki roshni aur chronos ret kinare par milti hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun driving the blade straight down into the unstable core cliffhanger
panels.action: Ha-Jun plunges his starlight blade straight into the center of the unstable supernova core!
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun plunges his starlight blade straight into the center of the unstable supernova core!.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-jun apne starlite blade ko sidhe asthir supernova core ke kendra mein dalta hai!
